data.title: DSI to review case over ballot QR codes
data.description: The Department of Special Investigation (DSI) will examine a complaint against eight people accused of trying to decode ballot codes in a Bangkok by-election, according to the justice minister.

data.title: Army denies  targeting Preah Vihear
data.description: The Royal Thai Army has rejected Cambodia's claim that Thai attacks damaged Preah Vihear temple, accusing Cambodian forces of using the World Heritage site as a military base.

data.title: Police raid 3 suspected scam hubs
data.description: Immigration police have arrested 14 people in raids on three Bangkok properties suspected of housing a scam and online gambling network linked to losses of more than 100 million baht.

data.title: PM ramps up drug crackdown
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has ordered authorities to intensify efforts to dismantle transnational drug trafficking networks and target production sources before the narcotics reach Thailand.

data.title: PP chief urges unity after chat leak
data.description: Opposition People's Party (PP) leader Natthaphong Ruengpanyawut has dismissed reports of internal divisions following leaked messages from the party's MPs' LINE group.

data.title: SX 2026 expo shifts towards resilience
data.description: The Sustainability Expo (SX 2026) will return to Bangkok from Nov 6-15, focusing on helping people adapt to a changing world by shifting attention from climate change mitigation to building resilience against its growing impacts.

data.title: Udon Thani plant expo 'ready to open'
data.description: The Udon Thani International Horticultural Expo 2026 is ready to welcome visitors from Nov 1, with 20,000–30,000 expected daily.

data.title: Suphajee to stay, says PM
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has vowed to keep Commerce Minister Suphajee Suthumpun in his cabinet amid rumours of an impending reshuffle, describing her as a "key pillar" of his administration.

data.title: Pattaya bike taxis switch back to orange after just five days in blue
data.description: Motorcycle taxi drivers in Chon Buri have been ordered to switch back to their traditional orange vests after just five days in blue ones. The reversal follows public concerns about road safety, the cost of new uniforms and the political implications of the colour change.

data.title: 12 injured after tourist boat hits Sathorn pier pontoon
data.description: Twelve people, including five foreign tourists, were injured when a double-decker tourist boat struck a floating pontoon at Sathorn pier near Saphan Taksin BTS station in Bangkok on Thursday afternoon.

data.title: Ex-MP raises more concerns about gambling site
data.description: Former Democrat MP Sirichok Sopha has urged law enforcement to trace funds linked to Shuffle.com, a gambling site blocked in Thailand, after the digital asset exchange Bitkub confirmed transactions exceeding 100 million baht involving 49 customers.

data.title: Customs to inspect all scrap metal containers for e-waste
data.description: The Thai Customs Department is physically inspecting every container declared as metal scrap as it steps up enforcement against illegal electronic waste imports, which have polluted the environment and threatened local livelihoods in the country’s eastern provinces.

data.title: Chinese suspects in Dubai abductions arrested in Bangkok
data.description: Two Chinese men have been arrested at luxury condominiums in Bangkok in connection with the abduction and detention of three people who were found dead in Dubai in June.

data.title: Thailand races to protect data after PHP alert
data.description: Thai authorities have urged organisations to urgently update websites and systems using PHP to prevent potential personal data leaks, with universities and medical school hospitals told to prioritise patient records and student databases.

data.title: Heat turned down on holy basil controversy
data.description: Thailand’s agriculture minister has stepped in to calm the nerves of farmers and foodies about access to holy basil for the country’s beloved phat kaphrao stir-fry.

data.title: 125 laughing gas cylinders seized from Bangkok condo
data.description: Police have arrested a 19-year-old man and seized 125 cylinders of nitrous oxide, commonly known as laughing gas, and related items in a raid on a condominium in Lat Phrao district of Bangkok.

data.title: Chinese fugitive’s toddler registered as Thai child of ‘fake father’
data.description: PATTAYA - Immigration police say a Chinese man wanted in his home country for running a major gambling business had his biological daughter registered as the child of a Thai man to obtain Thai nationality.

data.title: Air travellers alerted as typhoon warning issued in Taiwan
data.description: Thai Airways International has advised passengers on flights to and from Taipei and Kaohsiung between Thursday and Saturday to check schedules as they could be disrupted by the approaching Typhoon Champi.

data.title: Police raid Pathum Thani bar over prostitution
data.description: PATHUM THANI: Police have arrested a 44-year-old bar operator and detained five Vietnamese women during a raid on a beer bar in Thanyaburi district over alleged prostitution and illegal employment.

data.title: Phuket visitors bring in nearly B400bn
data.description: Phuket generated nearly 400 billion baht in tourism revenue in the first nine months of 2026 despite a slight decline in visitor numbers, as four international airlines prepare to launch direct routes ahead of the high season.
